description: This file defines the SystemStatus class, representing various states of a system within the Orleans runtime environment. It includes static readonly instances for each status, an internal enum to manage status values, and overrides for equality and string conversion methods.

classes.name: SystemStatus
classes.description: Represents the current status of the Orleans runtime system with predefined static instances and implements IEquatable for comparison.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Overrides Object.ToString to return the string representation of the current status.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.GetHashCode to provide a hash code based on the internal status value.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.Equals to compare with another object for equality.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Implements IEquatable<SystemStatus>.Equals to compare two SystemStatus instances for equality.
